name: obsidian-tab-flow
description: Render, play and create guitar tabs. Write tabs in text. Modern music font and sound! (.alphatab, .gp, .gp3, .gp4, .gp5, .gpx) Powered by alphaTab.js.

scripts.dev: npm run format && npm run lint:fix && node ./scripts/merge-styles.js --dir src/styles && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.build: node ./scripts/merge-styles.js --dir src/styles && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && echo ======================================= && echo ' build done.'
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run lint:fix && npm run format && npm run format:check && npm run build && echo ======================================= && echo ' All checks passed successfully!'

author: Jay Bridge
